$uid..validate: newData.hasChildren(['id','name','klass','team','score','answers','completed','submittedAt']) && newData.child('id').val() === auth.uid && newData.child('completed').val() === true && newData.child('name').isString() && newData.child('name').val().length <= 70 && newData.child('klass').isString() && newData.child('klass').val().length <= 12 && newData.child('score').isNumber() && newData.child('score').val() >= 0 && newData.child('score').val() <= 60
